Name: Realistic Grumpy Marlon for Make Marlon Real Mod
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere!

[/size][/color][size=3]So, I drew this Marlon in my own style, because I fell in love with the character as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2421870]WerewolfMaster[/url] wrote it, trying to make the image with the personality matching the character.
This alone doesn't do anything, you need to download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018]Make Marlon Real[/url] mod and then download this too, unzipped it and pasted it into the Mods folder and it will replace the original portrait automatically.
Enjoy!!! [/size][color=#ff0000][size=4]<3[/size][/color][size=3]

I thank [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2421870]WerewolfMaster[/url][/size][size=3] for creating such a fun mod, I also really like the other characters he/her wrote, and I think as soon as I have translated all of them I will draw their portraits.

[size=3]Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url][/size]

[/size]If you appreciate my work you can donate me a [size=3]coffee[/size][size=3]?[/size][size=3] [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi
[/url][/size][size=3]
Here is my Discord server. https://discord.gg/PEHYyagv6T
